name: Black Lumaban
source:
A hard-headed punk and newly turned zombie. He's surly, violent, and intense. ...He's also saved your life on multiple occasions. You arrived at this place together, for better or worse your fates are entwined.

[From [url=https://doubledeadstudio.itch.io/reanimated-heart/]Itch.io[/url]]
